gradientPack.title: Gradient Pack
gradientPack.description: Elevate your experience! Stand out with a beautiful complexion of colors.

maskedPack.title: Masked Pack
maskedPack.description: Mask your identity with a variety of items.

dapperPack.title: Dapper Pack
dapperPack.description: Embrace the detective life! Equip your character with a detective hat, a top hat, a stylish moustache, and even a monocle.

militaryPack.title: Military Pack
militaryPack.description: Get ready for action! Put on a hard helmet and a beret, and blend into the surroundings with multiple camouflage backgrounds.

piratePack.title: Pirate Pack
piratePack.description: Arr matey! Transform your character into a pirate with an eye patch, crooked teeth, and top it off with a pirate hat.

holidaysPack.title: Holidays Pack
holidaysPack.description: Get in the holiday spirit with a range of festive hats!

animalPack.title: Animal Pack
animalPack.description: Be cute and playful! Give your character bunny ears, cat ears, and adorable mouths. The ears will adapt to the background color you select.

halloweenPack.title: Halloween Pack
halloweenPack.description: Dive into the spooky season! Choose from chilling skeleton and zombie eyes, along with haunting mouths, to create a spooky and fun atmosphere in the game.

americanFootballPack.title: American Football Pack
americanFootballPack.description: Get ready for the big game! Equip your character with stylish football helmets in a variety of colors.

celebrationPack.title: Celebration Pack
celebrationPack.description: Party time! Bring the joy to your character with a collection of vibrant party hats in different colors.

orbPack.title: Orb Pack
orbPack.description: Light up your character! Glossy orb backgrounds that glow from within, in every color.

auroraPack.title: Aurora Pack
auroraPack.description: Bring the northern lights with you! Soft, glowing aurora backgrounds in six color blends.

sunburstPack.title: Sunburst Pack
sunburstPack.description: Shine bright! Bold sunburst backgrounds with rays spinning out behind your character, in every color.

astronautPack.title: Astronaut Pack
astronautPack.description: Ready for liftoff! Suit up with an astronaut helmet in five mission colors.

knightPack.title: Knight Pack
knightPack.description: Raise your shield! Ride into battle in a knight's helm or a great helm, each in five colors.

vikingPack.title: Viking Pack
vikingPack.description: Set sail for adventure! A horned helm in five colors and a mighty braided beard.

warPaintPack.title: War Paint Pack
warPaintPack.description: Paint up for battle! Half-face paint, a raider mask and claw marks, in every color.

riderPack.title: Rider Pack
riderPack.description: Helmet on, let's ride! A road helmet and a scooter helmet, each in five styles.

bowsPack.title: Bows & Butterflies Pack
bowsPack.description: Add a little sweetness! A butterfly clip, a polka-dot bow and a side bow, each in five colors.

gamerPack.title: Gamer Pack
gamerPack.description: Game on! Two gaming headsets and a pair of earbuds, each in five colors.

fastFoodPack.title: Fast Food Pack
fastFoodPack.description: Order up! Fries and a soda in five colors, plus a burger and a slice of pizza.

graduationPack.title: Graduation Pack
graduationPack.description: You did it! Toss your graduate cap and show off your diploma.

valentinePack.title: Valentine's Pack
valentinePack.description: Love is in the air! Rising hearts backgrounds, Cupid's arrow and a heart balloon.

lunarNewYearPack.title: Lunar New Year Pack
lunarNewYearPack.description: Ring in the new year! A red lantern, a firecracker, a red envelope and plum blossoms.

summerPack.title: Summer Pack
summerPack.description: Surf's up! A snorkel mask, swim goggles, ice cream and a coconut drink for sunny days.

winterPack.title: Winter Pack
winterPack.description: Bundle up! Snowdrift and frost backgrounds, ski goggles, a scarf, earmuffs and chattering teeth.

springPack.title: Spring Pack
springPack.description: Everything's blooming! Flower crowns and a cracked eggshell to welcome the spring.

autumnPack.title: Autumn Pack
autumnPack.description: Cozy season is here! A mushroom hat, a warm mug and a takeaway coffee.

stPatrickPack.title: St Patrick's Day Pack
stPatrickPack.description: Feeling lucky? A shamrock top hat, a pot of gold and a shamrock behind the ear.

festivalPack.title: Festival Pack
festivalPack.description: See you at the main stage! Face gems, star sunglasses, a bandana and a cowboy hat.

kingsDayPack.title: King's Day Pack
kingsDayPack.description: Go orange! Face paint, the Dutch flag, an inflatable crown, a party wig and a tompouce.

europePack.title: Europe Pack
europePack.description: United in diversity! The ring of stars and a flag to wave.

fourthOfJulyPack.title: Fourth of July Pack
fourthOfJulyPack.description: Happy Independence Day! Stars and stripes, a star-spangled top hat, a flag to wave and a hot dog.

oktoberfestPack.title: Oktoberfest Pack
oktoberfestPack.description: O'zapft is! The German flag, an Alpine hat and a fresh pretzel.

japanPack.title: Japan Pack
japanPack.description: Celebrate Golden Week! The Japanese flag, a koinobori, an onigiri and a hachimaki.

koreaPack.title: Korea Pack
koreaPack.description: Happy Chuseok! The Korean flag, the harvest moon, mugunghwa flowers and a gulle.

canadaPack.title: Canada Pack
canadaPack.description: Happy Canada Day! The Canadian flag, a Mountie hat and a maple leaf.

account.title: One step before you buy
account.description: Add your email so your packs and coins are safe on any device.

locker.unsaved: Saved when you press Done or close the locker.

coins.title: Coins
coins.forPackNote: Pay, and the pack is bought for you straight after.
coins.adsOff: Any coin purchase turns ads off, for good. Coins never expire.

checkout.title: Finish paying in the checkout
checkout.body: It opened over this page. We'll take it from here as soon as it's done.

confirming.title: Payment received
confirming.body: Adding your coins. This usually takes a few seconds.
confirming.packNote: You can close this. {pack} will be waiting in your locker.

done.title: Coins added
done.adsOff: Ads are off for good. Thanks for supporting Bloob.io!

failed.title: The payment didn't go through
failed.body: You weren't charged. Try again, or pick another way to pay in the checkout.
